provider.needs: Nothing. It is built in and works offline.

provider.by: Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM or a hosted service
provider.license: Depends on the server and model
provider.needs: A server that speaks /v1/chat/completions, set up once in Agent Chat.

provider.license: The browser maker's terms, such as Google's Generative AI Prohibited Uses Policy

Not on phones. Firefox and Safari do not offer it. Install asks the browser to fetch its model, once.
A browser with WebGPU, a copy of the WebLLM library supplied with Pea OS (Pea OS never downloads code), and room for a model, about 1 to 5 GB.

provider.by: Apple on iOS, Google on Android
provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on a phone or tablet, with a native bridge to the system's model.

provider.title: Disk (pos serve)
provider.about: Keeps files in a folder on this computer, through pos serve: documents, music, videos and renders, as ordinary files you can find and back up.
provider.needs: Pea OS opened from pos serve on this computer. Files go to ~/.local/share/pea-os/files, or the folder given with pos serve --data.
provider.absent: Not available here: only when Pea OS is opened from pos serve on a computer.

provider.title: Browser storage
provider.about: Keeps files inside this browser, for this site only. They stay until the browser's site data is cleared.
provider.needs: A browser with IndexedDB. Private windows may forget files when they close.
provider.absent: Not available here: only in a web browser.

provider.title: Phone storage
provider.about: Keeps files in Pea OS's own folder on the phone or tablet.
provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on Android or iOS.
provider.absent: Not available here: only when Pea OS runs natively on a phone or tablet.

provider.needs: Somewhere to keep preferences: localStorage in a browser. At most 2 MB.
Nothing. Files last until Pea OS closes.

provider.title: Browser audio
provider.by: The browser (HTML audio and Media Session)
provider.about: Plays through the browser's own media player, which shows on the lock screen and answers media keys and headsets.
provider.needs: A web browser. On phones, playback is left to the system's media player so it keeps going with the screen off.
provider.absent: Not available here: only in a web browser.

provider.title: Android media player
provider.by: Android (MediaPlayer, MediaSession, a media playback service)
provider.about: Plays through Android's media player in a foreground media service, so Android does not put it to sleep, with lock-screen controls.
provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on Android, built with the playback service declared (see README.md).
provider.absent: Not available here: only when Pea OS runs natively on Android.

provider.title: ffmpeg (pos serve)
provider.by: The FFmpeg project, run by pos serve
provider.license: LGPL 2.1 or GPL 2, depending on how ffmpeg was built
provider.about: Probes, previews and renders video with the ffmpeg already installed on this computer. Shotcut works the same way: a front end to ffmpeg.
provider.needs: Pea OS opened from pos serve, and ffmpeg and ffprobe on the PATH. Linux: install the ffmpeg package (dnf install ffmpeg, apt install ffmpeg). macOS: brew install ffmpeg. Windows: winget install ffmpeg. Restart pos serve after installing.
provider.absent: Not available here: only when Pea OS is opened from pos serve on a computer with ffmpeg.

provider.title: ffmpeg.wasm (in this browser)
provider.about: ffmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, running inside the page.
provider.needs: A copy of ffmpeg.wasm supplied with Pea OS (Pea OS never downloads code), and a browser with SharedArrayBuffer.
provider.absent: Not installed: ffmpeg.wasm is third-party code. Pea OS never downloads code; a copy supplied with Pea OS is needed.

provider.title: ffmpeg on Android
provider.by: The FFmpeg project, built for Android
provider.license: LGPL 2.1 or GPL 2, depending on the build
provider.about: ffmpeg's libraries built into the Pea OS app for Android.
provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on Android, with ffmpeg built into the app and a native bridge to it.
provider.absent: Not built yet: Pea OS for Android needs ffmpeg built into the app and a native bridge to it.

provider.title: Relay (pos serve)
provider.about: pos serve fetches each site for the page, so feeds and model servers that do not let pages read them still work.
provider.needs: Pea OS opened from pos serve on this computer.
provider.absent: Not available here: only in a browser page opened from pos serve.

provider.title: Phone network
provider.about: The phone's own network connection. A native app is not bound by browser rules, so it reaches any site.
provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on a phone or tablet.
provider.absent: Not available here: only when Pea OS runs natively on a phone or tablet.

provider.title: Direct from this page
provider.about: The page asks each site itself. Browsers allow that only for sites that let other pages read them, which many feeds and servers do not.
provider.needs: A web browser, and sites that allow it (CORS).
provider.absent: Not available here: only in a web browser.

provider.title: Android background work

provider.needs: Pea OS running natively on Android, with a native bridge to WorkManager.
provider.absent: Not built yet: Pea OS for Android needs a native bridge to WorkManager.

provider.needs: Nothing. Work runs while Pea OS is open.
